items.title: Floreat killer a ‘sad man’ who was ‘reeling’ after wife left him, inquest hears

children.content: The premeditated actions of a man who shot dead a mother and daughter in their Perth home showed "high-level" planning and it's unlikely his neurological conditions were a contributing factor, a court hears.
